backlog_dispositions.evidence: C02-L-Y-02, C03-S-05, C03-S-09, C03-L-B-01, and C03-L-Y-01 now separate social breadth, expressive exchange, belonging, and relational depth.
Yellow–Green continuity versus predictability improves through family tradition, household routine, team norms, and close-relationship tradeoffs, but pairwise depth still merits monitoring.
Decision ownership, result recovery, repeatable process, consequence comparison, and recurring-error control now provide multiple Red–Green windows.
PREFERENCE_IN_OTHERS remains only 4 of 120 items despite strong RESPONSE_TO_OTHERS growth.

Free time, hobbies, recreation, travel, neighborhood, household purchasing, recipes, and social contact materially improve positive ordinary-life coverage, but attraction/attention remains less deep than problem response.
Personal goals, travel, recreation, emerging projects, and recovery now provide repeated non-work Red progress versus Blue possibility contrasts.

Relational depth, known belonging, mutual support, family tradition, household continuity, and friendship conflict now provide non-virtue Yellow coverage; family/close-relationship parallel depth should still be monitored.
Blue freedom and variety are positively represented through evolving paths, expressive exchange, travel, fresh routines, exploration, and experience without relying on boredom or distractibility.
The governed four-color drain item remains the main direct measure; frustration and blocked-motive parallel coverage is still shallow.
